description.value:
I'm not hiding (RaintDM), this change is also purely intentional so that the Bard can use this weapon. It seems to me that, conceptually, a weapon that buffs your allies in combat using music is entirely Bardic, but Amellwind's homebrew takes the weapon purely as MH presents it, which is fine. However, I'm taking the creative liberty of making some changes so that it's possible for a Bard to use it.

Open Hunting Horn in the Toolbox

Features

Mastery (Topple)

If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force it to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength or Charisma modifier). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

Instrument of War (The Bard Fix)

This weapon doubles as a musical instrument and a spellcasting focus. If you have the Bardic Inspiration feature, you gain proficiency with this weapon, it loses the Heavy property for you (allowing Small races to wield it comfortably), and you can use your Charisma modifier instead of Strength for its attack and damage rolls.

Recital

Bonus Action.

The horn relies on the momentum of combat to generate its magic. When you hit a creature with this weapon on your turn, you can use your Bonus Action to perform a Recital. This ends all Melodies currently active from your Songbook, then activates one Melody of your choice. That Melody emits a 15-foot aura centered on you that lasts for 1 minute, until you are Incapacitated, or until you activate Melodies again.

▸ Upgrade — Encore

Your mastery over the horn's acoustics improves. When you perform a Recital, after ending all currently active Melodies you can activate two different Melodies at the same time instead of one.

Solo Recital

Bonus Action.

As a Bonus Action, you can perform a Solo Recital without hitting a creature. This ends all Melodies currently active from your Songbook, then activates one Melody of your choice. That Melody emits a 15-foot aura centered on you that lasts for 1 minute, until you are Incapacitated, or until you activate Melodies again.

Songbook

You know two Melodies of your choice. You can change your known Melodies whenever you finish a Long Rest.

▸ Upgrade — Expanded Songbook

You know three Melodies.

Melodies

Melody of Might

Allies in the aura (including you) can add [[/r 1d4]] to the damage rolls.

Melody of Swiftness

Allies in the aura have their Speed increased by 10 feet and ignore Difficult Terrain.

Melody of Precision

Allies in the aura gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls.

Melody of Guile

When you activate this Melody, choose one skill. Allies in the aura gain a +1 bonus to checks using that skill.

Melody of Warding

Allies in the aura gain a +1 bonus to their Armor Class.

Melody of Focus

Allies in the aura (including you) gain a +1 bonus to their spell save DCs.

Melody of Harmful Acid

Allies in the aura deal an extra [[/r 1d4]] Acid damage.

Melody of Harmful Cold

Allies in the aura deal an extra [[/r 1d4]] Cold damage.

Melody of Harmful Fire

Allies in the aura deal an extra [[/r 1d4]] Fire damage.

Melody of Harmful Lightning

Allies in the aura deal an extra [[/r 1d4]] Lightning damage.

Melody of Harmful Thunder

Allies in the aura deal an extra [[/r 1d4]] Thunder damage.
